sections.source: Zoe Life Website - About Page content and navigation updates
copy: About Zoe Life
Helping people thrive in every season of life.
Zoe Life was established out of our shared passion for God and people, and our desire to encourage, equip, and empower individuals, couples, and families to thrive in every season of life.

We believe that God’s Word provides the foundation for living a purposeful and fulfilling life. Through faith-based and practical coaching, teaching, books, and other resources, our desire is to help people grow in their relationship with God, develop personally, strengthen relationships, and navigate life’s opportunities and challenges with wisdom and confidence.

The name Zoe comes from the Greek word for life, used in John 10:10, where Jesus speaks of the abundant life He came to give. This Scripture reflects the heart behind Zoe Life. We desire to help people discover, experience, and walk in the fullness of life that God has made available through Jesus Christ.

Whether you’re seeking personal growth, guidance in relationships or marriage, support in parenting, or direction in education or career development, our heart is to provide encouragement, biblical wisdom, and practical resources that support you along the way.
Encouraging, Equipping, and Empowering People to Thrive

Our mission is to provide faith-based and practical coaching, teaching, encouragement, and resources that help individuals, couples, and families grow in faith, develop personally, strengthen relationships, make wise decisions, and thrive in every season of life.
Lives Transformed, Families Strengthened, and Communities Impacted

Our vision is to see individuals experiencing the abundant life that Jesus Christ came to give, growing in their relationship with God, and fulfilling His purpose for their lives. We desire to see marriages and families strengthened, individuals thriving in every season of life, and people making a positive difference in their homes, workplaces, churches, and communities.
Christ-Centered
Jesus Christ is the foundation of all we do. We desire to honor Him and point others toward Him through our work.
Biblical Truth
God’s Word is our foundation and final authority. We are committed to sharing biblical truth faithfully and encouraging its application in everyday life.
Practical Wisdom
We believe biblical principles should be lived out. Our desire is to help people apply God’s Word and practical wisdom to everyday decisions and experiences.
Excellence
We are committed to honoring God through excellence, diligence, and faithful service in all we do.
Integrity
We value honesty, accountability, and consistency between what we believe, teach, and practice.
Compassion
We desire to serve others with genuine love, kindness, patience, and understanding.
Stewardship
We seek to faithfully manage the time, opportunities, gifts, and resources God has entrusted to us.
Growth
We believe in continually growing in our relationship with God, developing personally, and becoming more effective in serving others.
Meet Tayo and Kemi Akinyemi

Tayo and Kemi Akinyemi are beloved children of God, husband and wife, parents of six children, pastors, and cofounders of Zoe Life LLC. Married for nearly twenty years, they serve together in pastoral leadership at Life Springs Church in Naperville, Illinois.

Their shared passion for God and people, together with their experiences in marriage, parenting, ministry, education, leadership, and their professional careers, inspired them to establish Zoe Life as a platform to encourage, equip, and empower others.

Through Zoe Life, they bring together biblical wisdom, practical insights, and personal and professional experiences to support individuals, couples, and families as they grow in faith, strengthen relationships, pursue their goals, and thrive in every season of life.
We Would Love to Hear From You!

Whether you have a question, would like to learn more about our coaching services, explore our books and resources, or connect with us about speaking engagements and other opportunities, we would love to hear from you. Feel free to send us a message or schedule a complimentary consultation to explore how we can support you.

sections.source: Zoe Life Website - Books Page Updates
copy: Resources to Encourage and Equip You.
We are excited to share books and resources created to encourage you in your walk with God, support your personal growth, and help you apply biblical principles in everyday life.

Our first two publications focus on something very close to our hearts: cultivating and maintaining a lifestyle of thanksgiving to God. We pray that these resources will encourage you to intentionally recognize God’s goodness and make gratitude a part of your daily life.
A 7-Day Gratitude Devotional
Cultivating a Heart of Thanksgiving to God
There is so much to be thankful to God for, and sometimes we simply need to be more intentional about recognizing and expressing our gratitude to Him.

This seven-day devotional invites you to spend time in God’s Word, reflect on His goodness, and express your thanksgiving through prayer. Each day provides Scripture, encouragement, reflection, and prayer to help you cultivate a heart of gratitude to God.

Whether you are beginning this journey or looking to strengthen your existing practice of thanksgiving, we pray that this devotional will encourage you to make gratitude to God a part of your everyday life.
A 100-Day Gratitude Journal
Cultivating a Lifestyle of Thanksgiving to God

God’s goodness and faithfulness give us countless reasons to be thankful, and we believe that taking time to intentionally reflect on them can help us develop a more consistent lifestyle of gratitude.
This 100-day guided journal provides an opportunity to pause each day, reflect on Scripture, consider God’s goodness in your own life, and express your personal thanksgiving to Him.

With daily Scriptures, gratitude reflections, and space to write your own thoughts and prayers, the journal encourages you to develop a habit of thanksgiving while creating a personal record of God’s faithfulness in your life.
Two Resources, One Journey of Thanksgiving
We are excited to share A 7-Day Gratitude Devotional and A 100-Day Gratitude Journal as two complementary resources to help you cultivate and maintain a lifestyle of thanksgiving to God.

The devotional provides seven days of Scripture, reflection, and prayer to encourage you to cultivate a heart of gratitude, while the journal provides an opportunity to continue reflecting on God’s goodness and expressing your personal thanksgiving to Him over 100 days.
You are welcome to purchase either book individually or get both to use together. They also make thoughtful gifts for friends, family, and others you would like to encourage.
Interested in Ordering Multiple Copies?
Planning to share our books with your church, ministry, small group, organization, friends, or family? We’d love to hear from you!
Whether you’re purchasing books for a group study, an event, or as gifts, feel free to reach out to discuss your needs and available ordering options.
Inquire About Group Orders
More Books and Resources Are on the Way!

We are excited about the additional books and resources we’re working on! Our heart is to continue sharing biblical encouragement and practical guidance to support you in your faith, personal growth, relationships, marriage, family life, and other areas of life.
We look forward to sharing more with you!

copy: Partner with Zoe Life
We believe that meaningful partnerships create opportunities to encourage, equip, and positively impact more lives.

At Zoe Life, we welcome opportunities to connect and collaborate with individuals, churches, ministries, organizations, and others who share our passion for helping people grow in faith, strengthen relationships, develop personally, and thrive in every season of life.

Whether you’re interested in working together on an initiative, inviting us to contribute to an event, sharing our resources with others, or exploring another opportunity for collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.
Ways We Can Partner
Collaborations & Joint Initiatives
Explore opportunities to work together on projects, programs, and initiatives that encourage personal growth, strengthen relationships, and support individuals and families.
Speaking Engagements & Workshops
Invite us to contribute to conferences, workshops, group sessions, or other events focused on faith, marriage, family life, personal development, education, and related topics.
Books & Resource Partnerships
Explore opportunities to share our books, devotionals, journals, and other resources with churches, groups, organizations, and communities.
Supporting Zoe Life Initiatives
We welcome opportunities to connect with individuals and organizations interested in sponsoring, contributing resources to, or otherwise supporting initiatives that align with Zoe Life’s mission.
Important Information About Financial Support
Zoe Life LLC is not a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit organization. Financial contributions or sponsorships made to Zoe Life are not tax-deductible charitable donations.
Let’s Explore Opportunities Together!

We’d love to hear your ideas and explore how we might work together. If you’re interested in partnering or collaborating with Zoe Life, please send us a message and tell us a little about what you have in mind.
Send a Partnership Inquiry
Our Statement of Faith

At Zoe Life, our faith in God and our commitment to His Word are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that God’s Word is the foundation for living a purposeful, fulfilling, and abundant life through Jesus Christ. Our beliefs guide what we teach, the resources we create, and how we serve others.
We believe:
The Word of God: The Bible is the inspired, authoritative, and trustworthy Word of God. It is our foundation for faith, teaching, and everyday living.
The One True God: There is one God, eternally existing in three persons: God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Spirit.
Jesus Christ: Jesus Christ is the Son of God, fully God and fully man. Through His life, sacrificial death, and resurrection, He has made salvation available to all who believe in Him.
Salvation by Grace Through Faith: Salvation is a gift from God, received by grace through faith in Jesus Christ. It cannot be earned through human effort or good works.
The Holy Spirit: The Holy Spirit dwells in every believer, empowering us to live godly lives, grow spiritually, understand and apply God’s Word, and fulfill God’s purpose for our lives.
The Value of Every Person: Every person is created in the image of God and is worthy of love, dignity, and respect.
The Church: The Church is the body of Christ, called to worship God, grow in faith, make disciples, and demonstrate His love and power to the world.

Marriage and Family: Marriage is a covenant established by God between one man and one woman, designed to reflect Christ’s relationship with His Church. We believe that God’s Word provides the foundation for building strong marriages and families.
Christian Living: God calls us to live lives of holiness, love, integrity, compassion, stewardship, and obedience to His Word, reflecting the character of Christ in our everyday lives.
The Return of Jesus Christ: We believe in the return of our Lord Jesus Christ and the fulfillment of God’s eternal promises and Kingdom.

These beliefs are foundational to Zoe Life. Through our coaching, teaching, books, and other resources, our desire is to remain faithful to God’s Word, encourage others to grow in their relationship with Him, and help individuals and families experience the abundant life Jesus Christ came to give.

copy: Privacy Policy
Zoe Life LLC
Effective Date: November 6, 2026
At Zoe Life LLC, we value your trust and respect your privacy. We are committed to handling the personal information you share with us responsibly and with care.

This Privacy Policy explains how Zoe Life LLC (“Zoe Life,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, shares, and protects personal information when you visit our website, www.zoelifehub.com, contact us, subscribe to our communications, purchase our products, or engage with our services.
1. Information We Collect
Depending on how you interact with Zoe Life, we may collect the following information:
Contact Information: Your name, email address, phone number, and other contact details you voluntarily provide.
Coaching and Consultation Information: Information you provide when requesting a consultation, completing an inquiry form, scheduling a session, or participating in our coaching services.
Purchase Information: Information related to purchases of books, digital resources, and other products or services. Payments may be processed through third-party payment providers.
Newsletter Information: Your email address and subscription preferences when you sign up to receive communications from Zoe Life.
Website Usage Information: Technical information such as browser type, device information, pages visited, and other usage data that may be collected through cookies or website analytics tools.
2. How We Use Your Information
We may use the information we collect to:
Respond to questions, inquiries, and requests.
Schedule consultations and coaching sessions.
Provide coaching, educational resources, and other services.
Process purchases and communicate about orders.
Send newsletters, encouragement, helpful resources, announcements, and updates when you have subscribed.
Improve our website, products, resources, and services.
Maintain appropriate business records and comply with applicable legal obligations.
We do not sell your personal information to third-party marketers.
3. Coaching Information and Confidentiality
We recognize that individuals, couples, and families may share personal or sensitive information when seeking coaching, encouragement, or guidance.
We seek to handle such information with care, discretion, and respect for your privacy.

Information shared through coaching inquiries and services is handled in accordance with our applicable coaching agreements and privacy practices. Confidentiality may be subject to legal obligations, safety considerations, and other exceptions described in the relevant coaching agreement.
We encourage visitors not to submit highly sensitive personal information through general website contact forms.
4. Third-Party Service Providers
We may use third-party service providers to support our website and business operations, including:
Website hosting and maintenance.
Appointment scheduling and virtual meetings.
Payment processing.
Email communications and newsletter management.
Product sales and digital resource delivery.
Website analytics and security.
These providers may process information as necessary to deliver their services, subject to their own privacy policies and applicable agreements.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies of third-party platforms when using their services.
5. Email Communications
If you subscribe to our mailing list, we may send you encouragement, helpful resources, announcements, and updates about Zoe Life’s books, services, events, and other offerings.
You may unsubscribe from our emails at any time using the unsubscribe link provided in our emails or by contacting us through the Contact Us form on our website.
6. Cookies and Website Analytics
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support website functionality, understand visitor interactions, and improve the user experience.
Depending on the technologies used, cookies may help us remember preferences, monitor website performance, or understand how visitors use our website.
Where applicable, visitors may be able to manage cookie preferences through their browser settings or available website controls.
7. Information Security
We take reasonable steps to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, loss, or disclosure.
However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
8. Data Retention

We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain appropriate business records, fulfill the purposes described in this policy, and comply with applicable legal obligations.
9. Your Privacy Choices
You may contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we maintain about you, subject to applicable laws and legitimate business or legal requirements.
You may also unsubscribe from our emails at any time.
To make a privacy-related request, please use the Contact Us form on our website.
10. Children’s Privacy
Our website is intended primarily for adults, including parents and guardians seeking resources for themselves and their families.
We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under the age of 13 through our website without appropriate parental consent.
If you believe a child has provided personal information to us without appropriate authorization, please contact us so that we can review the situation and take appropriate action.
11. External Websites
Our website may contain links to third-party websites, including social media platforms, retailers, and scheduling or payment services.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of websites that we do not operate.
We encourage visitors to review the privacy policies of external websites before sharing personal information.
12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our services, website practices, or legal requirements.
Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.
13. Contact Us
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle personal information, please reach out through the Contact Us form on our website.
Zoe Life LLC
Aurora, Illinois, United States
Website: www.zoelifehub.com
